resolved_conflicts.explanation: Wikipedia gives both 1884 and 1885 for Rotch founding the observatory; the story notes the disagreement and uses the Register's 1885 for the building.

The Register says active through 1915. A 1916 State Forester annual report says the Blue Hill lookout had been discontinued about two years earlier, which points to about 1914. The story gives both dates.
The Register's Milton Fire Tower is the weather observatory itself. Eliot Tower, a CCC stone tower built 1933-34 near the summit, is a different structure and is not part of this record.

notes_for_editor: The Register's Milton Fire Tower is the 1885 weather observatory, not a dedicated fire tower; the record's kind could read as a tower. No current access statement was read, so access is omitted rather than guessed. The Blue Hill Observatory & Science Center timeline page had no usable text. The Forest Fire Lookout Association Facebook post on this site could not be fetched. Staffing is limited to the lookout years; no names found.
